d:
BJP has released a rap video titled “Modi Kahin Nahi Jayenge” in response to Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s controversial remark about PM Narendra Modi. Congress has also hit back by sharing Rahul Gandhi’s video accusing PM Modi, Amit Shah and CEC Gyanesh Kumar of vote theft. Ahead of the INDIA bloc’s November 1 march at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan, the political battle between BJP and Congress is intensifying on social media.
